_readme: Sample answer file for fdr-vcenter-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.
Deployment uses custom vCenter placement. Appliance identity and IP configuration remain those in the existing extracted SDDC data.
This plan has no cmdlet answer-file prompts, so no cmdlet keys are required. Deployment and backup settings belong in the matching variables file.
Set vCenterBackupPassword in the variables file only for an encrypted backup; otherwise leave it blank.
